name: Kashmir — Paradise Circuit
desc: Houseboat night on Dal Lake, gondola to Apharwat, and a saffron-farm lunch in Pampore.
lede: Seven days across the valley Mughal emperors called paradise — shikaras at sunset, alpine meadows at Gulmarg, and a night aboard a cedar houseboat on Dal Lake.
itin: Airport pickup, check-in, and an evening shikara ride on Dal Lake as the lights come on.
Gondola to Kongdoori station; snow play in season, meadow walks in summer. Overnight Srinagar.
Drive via Pampore saffron fields and Avantipora ruins. Evening by the Lidder river.
Full day in Pahalgam's film-famous valleys; optional pony trek to Baisaran.
Nishat, Shalimar and Pari Mahal, then a wazwan dinner in the old city.
Free morning, then check into a deluxe houseboat — kahwa on the deck at dusk.
Drop at Srinagar airport with saffron and dry fruits in the bag.
inc: Private cab for all transfers & sightseeing
All tolls, parking and driver charges

name: Kerala — Hills & Backwaters
desc: Tea-estate stay in Munnar, spice-garden walk, and a private houseboat drifting through Alleppey.
lede: Six days from mist-covered tea country down to the slow green canals of Alleppey — ending with a private houseboat and a candlelit dinner on deck.
itin: Drive up through waterfalls and rubber plantations; check into a tea-estate stay.
Eravikulam National Park, tea museum, and Top Station viewpoint.
Spice-garden walk and an optional Periyar lake cruise; Kathakali show at night.
Board a private houseboat by noon — cruise, swim stops, and dinner on deck.
Disembark after breakfast; Fort Kochi walk — Chinese nets, Jew Town, café stop.
inc: Daily breakfast; all meals on houseboat

name: Rajasthan — Royal Trail
desc: Amber Fort at sunrise, blue-city walking tour, and dinner overlooking Lake Pichola.
lede: Eight days through the three great royal cities — pink, blue and white — with heritage stays, stepwells, and one dinner you'll talk about for years, overlooking Lake Pichola.
itin: Check into a heritage haveli; evening at Nahargarh for the city-lights view.
Amber Fort early, then City Palace, Jantar Mantar and the bazaars of Johari.
Drive via the stepwells of Toorji ka Jhalra; sunset from the clock-tower market.
Mehrangarh Fort and the blue-city walking tour with a local guide.
Via Ranakpur's 1,444-pillar Jain temple — no two carved alike.
City Palace, Saheliyon ki Bari, and an evening boat to Jag Mandir.
Free day — art walk, cooking class, or nothing at all. Farewell dinner over Pichola.

name: Goa — Sun & Susegad
desc: Beachfront stay, old-Goa heritage loop, and a sunset cruise on the Mandovi.
lede: A long weekend done properly: beachfront stay, one lazy heritage day, one boat, and no alarm clocks.
itin: Airport pickup, resort check-in, shack lunch, sea.
Aguada fort, Anjuna flea market (Wednesdays), sunset at Vagator.
Basilica of Bom Jesus, Sé Cathedral, Latin-quarter walk in Fontainhas; evening Mandovi cruise.
Late checkout where possible; airport drop.
inc: North Goa + heritage sightseeing by private cab

name: Himachal — Shimla & Manali
desc: Toy-train ride to Shimla, Solang Valley ropeway, and riverside café evenings in Old Manali.
lede: The classic hill double-bill — colonial Shimla by toy train, then over the hills to Manali for snow points, ropeways and riverside cafés.
itin: Optional toy-train leg from Kalka; evening on the Ridge and Mall Road.
Kufri viewpoint, Green Valley, and Jakhoo temple's giant Hanuman.
Scenic drive along the Beas; riverside check-in.
Ropeway, paragliding (optional), and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in season.
Hadimba temple, Vashisht hot springs, Old Manali cafés.
Drive down to Chandigarh / Delhi overnight Volvo option.

name: Sikkim & Darjeeling
desc: Kanchenjunga sunrise from Tiger Hill, monastery mornings, and first-flush tastings at a working estate.
lede: Six days in the eastern Himalaya — prayer flags over Gangtok, the high lake at Tsomgo, and a 4 am date with Kanchenjunga from Tiger Hill.
itin: Pickup from Bagdogra; evening on MG Marg.
High-altitude lake and Baba Mandir (permits arranged); yak-side photos mandatory.
Rumtek monastery en route; tea-estate check-in.
Kanchenjunga at dawn, Ghoom monastery, Batasia loop, toy-train joyride.
Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, zoo, Mall Road, first-flush tasting.
inc: Private cab + shared permits vehicle for Tsomgo

name: Ooty & Kodaikanal
desc: Nilgiri mountain railway, boat house mornings on Kodai lake, and homemade chocolate trails.
lede: The gentle south-Indian hills — heritage rail through the Nilgiris, botanical gardens, lake mornings, and enough homemade chocolate to justify the walks.
itin: Pickup from Coimbatore; botanical gardens and chocolate shopping.
Heritage toy-train leg, Sim's Park, Dolphin's Nose viewpoint.
Drive through the plains and back up; lakeside evening.
Coaker's Walk, pillar rocks, pine forest, cycle around the lake.
Drive down to Madurai / Coimbatore airport.

name: Kashi & Ayodhya Darshan
desc: Dawn boat aarti on the Ganga, Ram Mandir darshan with priority passes, and Sangam snan.
lede: Four unhurried days across the holiest triangle in the north — dawn on the Ganga, darshan at the new Ram Mandir, and a dip at the Sangam.
itin: Evening Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh ghat from a reserved boat.
Dawn boat ride, Kashi Vishwanath darshan via corridor, Sarnath in the afternoon.
Ram Mandir darshan with assistance, Hanuman Garhi, Saryu aarti.
Sangam snan and Bade Hanuman ji; drop at Prayagraj / Varanasi.
inc: Reserved boat for aarti & dawn ride

name: Bali — Island of Temples
desc: Rice-terrace walks, Uluwatu sunset kecak dance, and a Nusa Penida day cruise. Visa on arrival.
lede: Six days between jungle and reef — an Ubud villa among the rice terraces, the kecak fire dance at Uluwatu, and a fast-boat day on Nusa Penida.
itin: Visa on arrival; transfer to an Ubud pool villa.
Tegalalang terraces, sacred monkey forest, Tirta Empul water temple.
Via Tanah Lot sea temple; beach evening.
Fast-boat day trip — Kelingking, Angel's Billabong, snorkelling.
Free morning, then clifftop temple and the kecak fire dance at sunset; seafood dinner at Jimbaran.

name: Dubai — Gold & Dunes
desc: Burj Khalifa at the top, desert safari with BBQ dinner, and a dhow cruise on the Marina.
lede: Five days of the Gulf's greatest hits — the view from the 124th floor, dune-bashing at golden hour, and the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in white marble.
itin: Evening Marina dhow cruise with dinner.
Old Dubai, souks and abra ride; Burj Khalifa at sunset, fountain show.
Free morning (mall time); afternoon dune-bashing, camel rides, BBQ under the stars.
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, corniche drive, Ferrari World photo stop.

name: Thailand — Twin Cities
desc: Grand Palace and floating markets, then island-hopping by speedboat from Phuket.
lede: Temples and floating markets in Bangkok, then south to Phuket for a speedboat day around the Phi Phi islands — the classic first Thailand trip, done right.
itin: Evening at Asiatique riverfront night market.
Grand Palace, Wat Pho's reclining Buddha, long-tail canal ride.
Damnoen Saduak morning, afternoon flight south.
Full-day speedboat — Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, snorkelling, island lunch.
Free day — Big Buddha, old town, or a beach and a massage.
inc: Phi Phi speedboat tour with lunch

name: Maldives — Lagoon Escape
desc: Overwater villa with all meals, sunset dolphin cruise, and a candlelit sandbank dinner.
lede: Four days of exactly nothing — an overwater villa with steps into the lagoon, meals included, and one candlelit dinner on a private sandbank.
itin: Speedboat/seaplane to the resort; villa check-in and lagoon time.
House-reef snorkelling, kayaks, spa hour; sunset dolphin cruise.
Nothing scheduled on purpose; candlelit sandbank dinner at dusk.

name: Uttarakhand — Lakes & Ganga
desc: Boat mornings on Naini Lake, Mall Road evenings in Mussoorie, and Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.
lede: Six days through Dev Bhoomi — lake country in Nainital, colonial Mussoorie, and down to the Ganga for aarti at Rishikesh and Haridwar.
itin: Pickup from Kathgodam; lake boating and Mall Road at dusk.
Snow View ropeway, Naina Devi temple, Bhimtal & Sattal lake loop.
Drive the Kumaon–Garhwal stretch; evening on Camel’s Back Road.
Kempty Falls, Gun Hill ropeway, Company Garden and Landour bakeries.
Laxman Jhula walk and river cafés; grand Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.
Morning dip at the ghats if you like; drop at Haridwar station / Dehradun airport.
inc: All hill permits, tolls and parking

name: Northeast — Meghalaya & Kaziranga
desc: Living root bridges, the wettest cliffs on earth, and a jeep safari among one-horned rhinos.
lede: Seven days in the green Northeast — Umiam Lake and Shillong’s cafés, the waterfalls of Cherrapunji, and dawn safaris in Kaziranga’s rhino country.
itin: Drive past Umiam Lake; evening at Police Bazar.
Elephant Falls, Shillong Peak, Ward’s Lake and café hopping.
Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai caves, Seven Sisters viewpoint.
Short trek to a living root bridge; Mawlynnong village and the India–Bangladesh viewpoint.
Drive into Assam; evening cultural show at the resort.
Early jeep safari in the central range — rhinos, wild buffalo, elephants; afternoon at leisure.
Drive back to Guwahati; Kamakhya darshan if time permits, airport drop.

name: Saurashtra — Gir & the Coast
desc: Asiatic lions at dawn, aarti by the Arabian Sea at Somnath, and Portuguese lanes in Diu.
lede: Six days around the Kathiawar peninsula — the last wild lions of Asia at Gir, the sea-facing jyotirlinga at Somnath, lazy Diu, and Krishna’s Dwarka.
itin: Drive to Sasan Gir; evening at the interpretation zone.
Dawn jeep safari for Asiatic lions; afternoon drive to Somnath, evening aarti.
Temple corridor and light-and-sound show memories; on to Diu’s beaches.
Diu fort, St. Paul’s church, Nagoa beach — slow day.
Coastal drive; evening Dwarkadhish temple aarti.
Nageshwar jyotirlinga and Bet Dwarka boat trip; drop at Jamnagar / Rajkot.
inc: Private cab for the full circuit

name: Andaman — Islands & Reefs
desc: Radhanagar sunsets, snorkelling over living coral, and the Cellular Jail light-and-sound show.
lede: Six days across the Andamans — history at Cellular Jail, Asia’s best beach at Radhanagar, and the quiet reefs of Neil Island.
itin: Airport pickup; Cellular Jail visit and the evening light-and-sound show.
Morning cruise; check in and sunset at Radhanagar Beach.
Boat to Elephant Beach — snorkelling over the reef; free afternoon.
Short ferry; Bharatpur and Laxmanpur beaches, Natural Bridge at low tide.
Return cruise; Corbyn’s Cove and local markets.
Airport drop with island time firmly installed.
inc: 5 nights’ stay (beach resorts + Port Blair hotel)
All transfers and sightseeing by private cab
exc: Snorkelling gear hire beyond Elephant Beach trip

name: Ujjain & Omkareshwar Darshan
desc: Bhasma aarti at Mahakaleshwar, the island jyotirlinga at Omkareshwar, and Indore’s Sarafa night market.
lede: Four days, two jyotirlingas — the pre-dawn bhasma aarti at Mahakaleshwar in Ujjain, the Narmada island shrine of Omkareshwar, and Indore’s famous street food in between.
itin: Pickup, Rajwada and Lal Bagh palace; eat your way through Sarafa after dark.
Mahakal Lok corridor and Mahakaleshwar darshan; Ram Ghat aarti on the Shipra.
Pre-dawn bhasma aarti (slots arranged), then drive to Omkareshwar for darshan and the parikrama.
Return to Indore; airport / station drop.

name: Vaishno Devi & Amritsar
desc: The Bhawan climb from Katra, langar at the Golden Temple, and the Wagah border ceremony.
lede: Five days of the north’s two great shrines — the 13-km yatra to Vaishno Devi’s Bhawan, and Amritsar’s Golden Temple with langar, kada prasad and the Wagah retreat.
itin: Pickup and drive to Katra; yatra parchi and early night.
Begin the climb early — Ardhkuwari, Bhawan darshan, Bhairon temple; ponies/helicopter optional.
Rest the legs on the drive; evening palki sahib at the Golden Temple.
Morning darshan and langar, Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum; Wagah border retreat at sunset.
Hall Bazaar juttis and papad-warian to pack; airport / station drop.

name: Kamakhya Devi Darshan
desc: Darshan at the great Shakti Peeth on Nilachal Hill and a ferry to the island temple of Umananda.
lede: A compact three-day yatra to the most revered Shakti Peeth — Kamakhya atop Nilachal Hill, the river island shrine of Umananda, and sunset on the Brahmaputra.
itin: Pickup; Basistha ashram and Kalakshetra; evening Brahmaputra cruise.
Early darshan at Kamakhya (queue assistance), the ten Mahavidya temples on the hill; ferry to Umananda.
Second darshan for those who wish; airport / station drop.

name: Jagannath Puri & Konark
desc: Mahaprasad at Jagannath temple, the Sun Temple’s stone chariot, and golden-sand evenings on Puri beach.
lede: Four days on Odisha’s golden triangle — Lord Jagannath’s Puri, the World-Heritage Sun Temple at Konark, and the ancient temples of Bhubaneswar.
itin: Lingaraj temple en route; evening on Puri beach.
Early Jagannath darshan with panda assistance; Mahaprasad; Swargadwar and the beach market.
Sun Temple with guide, Chandrabhaga beach, Pipili appliqué village on return.
Gundicha temple parikrama; drop at Bhubaneswar airport / station.

name: Ashtavinayak Yatra
desc: All eight swayambhu Ganpati temples of Maharashtra in one smooth, well-sequenced circuit.
lede: The classic three-day parikrama of Maharashtra’s eight self-manifested Ganpatis — Morgaon to Ranjangaon — sequenced the traditional way, with clean stays and no rushing.
itin: Mayureshwar first as tradition asks; Siddhivinayak at Siddhatek and Chintamani at Theur; night halt.
Climb to the Girijatmaj cave shrine, Vigneshwar at Ozar, Mahaganpati at Ranjangaon; night halt.
Ballaleshwar at Pali and Varadvinayak at Mahad; back to Pune/Mumbai by evening.
inc: AC vehicle for the full circuit

name: Dwarka–Somnath & Statue of Unity
route: Statue of Unity · Dwarka · Somnath · Girnar
desc: Two jyotirlingas, Krishna’s capital, the Girnar hill shrines — and the world’s tallest statue.
lede: Six days across Gujarat’s sacred west — the Statue of Unity at Kevadia, Dwarkadhish and Nageshwar, sunset aarti at Somnath, and the stairway pilgrimage up Girnar.
highlights: Statue of Unity & valley of flowers
itin: Statue of Unity viewing gallery, Sardar Sarovar dam, laser show.
Long scenic drive with breaks; evening at Gomti ghat.
Dwarkadhish darshan, Nageshwar jyotirlinga, Bet Dwarka boat visit, Rukmini temple.
Coastal drive via Porbandar (Kirti Mandir); Somnath darshan and sandhya aarti.
Bhalka Tirth and Triveni Sangam; Girnar ropeway to Ambaji, Uparkot fort.
inc: Private cab for the full circuit

name: Akkalkot, Pandharpur & Gangapur
desc: Swami Samarth’s Akkalkot, Vitthal’s Pandharpur and the Datta kshetra at Gangapur in one circuit.
lede: Three unhurried days through southern Maharashtra’s beloved shrines — Akkalkot, Pandharpur, Tuljapur and Gangapur — the circuit our group yatris ask for most.
itin: Swami Samarth darshan and math; Tulja Bhavani in the afternoon; night halt.
Chandrabhaga snan and Vitthal-Rukmini darshan with queue assistance; Pundalik temple.
Datta darshan and Nirgun Padukas, Bhima-Amarja sangam; return to Solapur by evening.

name: Char Dham Yatra
desc: The complete Uttarakhand Char Dham with acclimatised pacing, fixed hotels and yatra registration handled.
lede: Ten days to the four Himalayan dhams — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath — paced sensibly, registered properly, and supported the whole way.
itin: Yatra registration check, Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.
Via Mussoorie and Kempty Falls; acclimatisation evening.
Janki Chatti trek (6 km; ponies available), darshan, back to Barkot.
Darshan on the Bhagirathi; Harsil valley stop; return Uttarkashi.
Long mountain drive via Tehri lake views.
Early start for the 16-km trek (ponies/heli optional), darshan, night near the dham or Sitapur.
Via Ukhimath and Chopta’s meadows; evening Tapt Kund and darshan.
Mana village — the last village of India; drive down via Karnaprayag.
Devprayag sangam view; drop at Haridwar / Dehradun.
inc: Private cab for the entire yatra
Oxygen cylinder & basic first aid in vehicle

name: Delhi, Agra & Mathura
desc: Taj Mahal at sunrise, Old Delhi by rickshaw, and Janmabhoomi darshan with Vrindavan’s evening aarti.
lede: Five days on the classic northern arc — imperial Delhi, the Taj at first light, Agra Fort, and the Krishna heartland of Mathura and Vrindavan.
itin: India Gate drive, Humayun’s Tomb, Qutub Minar.
Red Fort, Chandni Chowk rickshaw ride, Raj Ghat, Akshardham evening show.
Via Yamuna Expressway; Agra Fort and Mehtab Bagh sunset view of the Taj.
Taj Mahal at dawn; Krishna Janmabhoomi, Banke Bihari and Prem Mandir lights.
Drop at Delhi airport / station via Mathura.
inc: Private cab for the full circuit
Taj Mahal & Agra Fort entry (Indian nationals)
Local guide in Delhi and Agra

name: Rameshwaram, Madurai & Kanyakumari
desc: Meenakshi’s towering gopurams, the Pamban bridge crossing, and sunrise at land’s end.
lede: Five days at the tip of India — Madurai’s Meenakshi temple, the island jyotirlinga of Rameshwaram across the Pamban bridge, and the three-sea sunrise at Kanyakumari.
itin: Meenakshi darshan and the evening night ceremony; Thirumalai Nayak palace.
Across Pamban bridge; Ramanathaswamy darshan and the 22 teerthams.
Land’s-end drive to Dhanushkodi; on to Kanyakumari for sunset.
Sunrise where three seas meet; Vivekananda Rock ferry, Thiruvalluvar statue, Suchindram temple.

name: Bangalore, Mysore & Ooty
desc: The illuminated Mysore Palace, Brindavan’s dancing fountains, and the Nilgiri toy train.
lede: Six easy days through the classic south — Bangalore’s gardens, Mysore’s palace lit by a hundred thousand bulbs, and up the Nilgiris to Ooty.
itin: Lalbagh, Vidhana Soudha drive-past, Cubbon Park; brigade-road evening.
Srirangapatna en route; Mysore Palace and the Sunday-style illumination; Brindavan Gardens.
Chamundi Hill, Mysore zoo or Jaganmohan gallery; silk and sandal shopping.
Up through Bandipur’s forest road (wildlife sightings common); Ooty lake evening.
Toy-train joyride to Coonoor, Doddabetta peak, botanical gardens, tea factory.
Drive down to Coimbatore / back to Bangalore.
inc: All parking, tolls and forest fees

name: Hyderabad & Ramoji Film City
desc: Charminar and biryani in the old city, Golconda’s acoustics, and a full day on the world’s largest film set.
lede: Four days in the City of Pearls — Charminar’s bazaars, Golconda fort, the Nizam’s treasures, and a full-day pass to Ramoji Film City.
itin: Hussain Sagar promenade, Buddha statue ferry, Lumbini park evening.
Charminar, Mecca Masjid, Laad Bazaar bangles, Salar Jung Museum; Golconda light-and-sound show.
Full-day entry with shows, sets and the studio tour; evening at leisure.
Shilparamam crafts village if time permits; airport drop.
inc: Ramoji Film City entry with transfers

name: Murudeshwar & Gokarna
desc: The towering seaside Shiva of Murudeshwar and Gokarna’s Mahabaleshwar darshan with beach-hop evenings.
lede: Four days on the Karavali coast — darshan under Murudeshwar’s colossal seaside Shiva, the Atmalinga at Gokarna, and golden evenings on Om and Kudle beaches.
itin: Pickup from Bhatkal/Mangalore; temple darshan and the 20-storey gopura viewing gallery.
Coastal drive; Mahabaleshwar temple and Koti Teertha; Gokarna main beach evening.
Boat-hop Om, Half-moon and Paradise beaches; sunset at Om viewpoint.
Mirjan fort en route; drop at Gokarna Road / Ankola station.

name: Hampi & Badami
desc: The boulder-strewn ruins of Vijayanagara and the rock-cut cave temples of the Chalukyas.
lede: Four days in Karnataka’s open-air museum — the stone chariot and bazaars of Hampi, then the Chalukyan cave temples of Badami, Pattadakal and Aihole.
itin: Virupaksha temple, Hampi bazaar, Hemakuta hill sunset.
Vittala temple and the stone chariot, Royal Enclosure, Lotus Mahal, elephant stables; coracle ride.
Morning at Matanga Hill; drive to Badami, cave temples at golden hour.
The Chalukyan trail; drop at Hubli / Hospet.
